QuestInfo.name: Where It All Started
QuestInfo.0: You tried to get help from Athena Pierce, but she already forgot who you are. She said she remembered you not long ago, but now... Is there any hope?
QuestInfo.1: You realized that your existence is forgotten each time you travel between worlds. This does nothing to soften the blow of losing your friends and allies, though. Now you are at the Temple of Time, where it all started, but can you find the solution you're looking for here?\r\n\r\n#rTip: Talk to the Temple Keeper to complete the quest.
QuestInfo.2: You realized that your existence is forgotten each time you travel between worlds. This does nothing to soften the blow of losing your friends and allies, though. Perhaps there is a solution hidden somewhere in the Temple of Time.

0.0: (Even Athena Pierce forgot about me... Only a few days ago she remembered--wait. Thinking about when she forgot me and when the foxes forgot me... They're both when...when #r#eI moved between worlds#n#k.)
0.1: (Does this mean that my existence is erased each time I leave a world? Am I doomed to lose my friends so easily? I don't know how I can ever deal with this.)
0.2: (I must find a way out. Find out why this is happening. I should go back to where it all started, the #rTemple of Time#k.)

1.0: We are not accepting regular visitors at the moment. Please leave.
